evidence.text: Can the non-geometric part of toroidal O(d,d) symmetry be identified directly in the higher-dimensional supergravity action, constrain its couplings, and admit explicit first-order α′ corrections with an invariant action and closed transformation algebra?

sources.title: 11D Supergravity and Hidden Symmetries

evidence.text: How do toroidal reductions of maximal eleven- and ten-dimensional supergravity acquire exceptional hidden symmetries, why is dualization essential, and how does exceptional field theory expose these structures before dimensional reduction?

sources.title: Trivector symmetry of 11-dimensional supergravity

evidence.text: Can the non-geometric tri-vector generator of toroidally reduced supergravity be realized covariantly in eleven dimensions, and which dual fields are needed to extend its action from field strengths to potentials?

sources.title: Hitchin functionals in N=2 supergravity

evidence.text: How can type II supergravity on backgrounds admitting eight selected supercharges be organized in an N=2-like form, and how do intrinsic torsion and fluxes determine its geometry, prepotentials and possible four-dimensional truncations?

sources.title: An E(9) multiplet of BPS states

evidence.text: What spacetime interpretation do positive real E9 roots and higher E10 fields admit, and can Weyl transformations generate an infinite BPS multiplet and explain its generalized dual potentials?

sources.title: Coupling of M-branes in M theory

evidence.text: How can eleven-dimensional supergravity and electrically charged membranes and dyonic five-branes be described as a closed dynamical system, and how can a duality-symmetric formulation yield a five-brane coupling involving only the standard three-form potential?

sources.title: U duality as general coordinate transformations, and space-time geometry

evidence.text: Can the full Cremmer–Julia symmetries be generated from internal coordinate transformations in the eleven-dimensional and type IIB reduction pictures, intertwined by T-duality, and how does this explain duality identifications of torus geometry?

sources.title: <math display="inline"><mi>β</mi></math> Symmetry of Supergravity

evidence.text: A frame formulation converts variations into flattened-index expressions for the vielbein, two-form, connections, H and dilaton derivatives. These variations are then used to impose invariance of the two-derivative Lagrangian.

sources.title: 11D Supergravity and Hidden Symmetries

evidence.text: Introduce dual potentials through first-order duality equations exchanging Bianchi identities and equations of motion. The Ehlers example explicitly uses a parent action with a Lagrange multiplier to replace a three-dimensional vector by a scalar.

sources.title: Trivector symmetry of 11-dimensional supergravity

evidence.text: Extend the field content recursively: reinterpret dual equations of motion as Bianchi identities, introduce dual potentials, and match general transformation ansätze after imposing duality relations. Young-symmetry restrictions and field redefinitions reduce the dual-gravity ansatz.

sources.title: Hitchin functionals in N=2 supergravity

evidence.text: Prepotentials are extracted by shifting the gravitino to diagonalize kinetic terms and projecting its variation onto SU(3) singlets. Finite form expansions, p-form gauge invariance and d²=0 then constrain the KK ansatz; the torsion vectors obey V_a·V_b=0.

sources.title: An E(9) multiplet of BPS states

evidence.text: Combine Weyl conjugations with Hodge duality and compensating SO(2) or SO(1,1) transformations to restore Borel form and express higher tower fields through the supergravity metric and three-form.

sources.title: Coupling of M-branes in M theory

evidence.text: The reported strategy constructs a bulk action containing A(3) and A(6), couples it to the five-brane while preserving auxiliary-field symmetries, and eliminates A(6) using an algebraic part of the duality relation.

sources.title: Higher derivative supergravities in diverse dimensions

evidence.text: What higher-derivative supergravity invariants, construction methods, supersymmetry transformations, Killing-spinor solutions and duality constraints are known across 1≤D≤11?

sources.title: Consistent truncations and dualities

evidence.text: Do generalised T-dualities and consistent truncations in generalised geometry correspond one-to-one? The paper establishes the direction from generalised cosets to consistent truncations and investigates what obstructs the converse.

sources.title: Higher-form symmetries in supergravity, scalar charges and black-hole thermodynamics

evidence.text: How do local/global symmetries, conserved currents, scalar charges and black-object thermodynamics of minimal five-dimensional supergravity relate to those of its circle reduction, the four-dimensional T3 model?

sources.title: Populating the swampland: The Case of U(1)**496 and E(8) x U(1)**248

evidence.text: What shared lower-dimensional structure permits comparison of the four ten-dimensional theories? Toroidal reduction gives a common orthogonal scalar coset and generic Abelian gauge fields, allowing the paper to compare duality identifications and charged classical solutions.

sources.title: Unified non-metric (1, 0) tensor-Einstein supergravity theories and (4, 0) supergravity in six dimensions

evidence.text: Assuming an interacting six-dimensional non-metric (4,0) supergravity exists, what lower-supersymmetry truncations, unified tensor–Einstein theories, and exceptional-field-theory uplifts could reproduce five-dimensional unified Maxwell–Einstein supergravities?

sources.title: Dynamical equations from a first-order perturbative superspace formulation of 10D, N=1 string-corrected supergravity. (I)

evidence.text: Does the proposed first-order deformation of 10D, N=1 superspace yield bosonic equations admitting compatible component actions in both two-form and six-form formulations, and equivalence to the gravitational part of the existing anomaly-free component action?

sources.title: Fiber bundles and generalized dimensional reduction

evidence.text: How do global symmetries enable consistent generalized reductions of eleven- and ten-dimensional supergravities, and what restrictions do global geometry and topology impose on the compactification and resulting masses?

sources.title: Supergravities: From fields to branes

evidence.text: How is eleven-dimensional supergravity constructed by deforming a free supersymmetric theory, and how can its toroidally reduced bosonic matter equations acquire a universal self-duality form, with possible quantum and gravitational extensions?

sources.title: Consistent Kaluza-Klein Truncations and Two-Dimensional Gauged Supergravity

evidence.text: Can generalized Scherk–Schwarz reduction of E9 exceptional field theory determine the scalar potential of upliftable two-dimensional maximal gauged supergravities and constructively establish the SO(9) sphere truncation?

sources.title: Introductory Lectures on Extended Supergravities and Gaugings

evidence.text: How does gauging deform extended supergravity to introduce gauge interactions, fermion masses and a scalar potential while preserving local supersymmetry, and how does the embedding tensor organize dualities and flux compactifications?

sources.title: N=2 supergravity and N=2 superYang-Mills theory on general scalar manifolds: Symplectic covariance, gaugings and the momentum map

evidence.text: How can general matter-coupled N=2 supergravity, its isometry gaugings and scalar potential be formulated geometrically without requiring special coordinates or a holomorphic prepotential, and how does the rigid theory emerge?

sources.title: Duality in N=1, D = 10 superspace and supergravity with tree level superstring corrections

evidence.text: How are the usual three-form and dual seven-form formulations of N=1, D=10 supergravity related after tree-level superstring corrections, and can the simpler dual equations yield a bosonic action?

sources.title: Tri-Sasakian consistent reduction

evidence.text: Can eleven-dimensional supergravity on any seven-dimensional tri-Sasakian manifold admit a universal consistent truncation retaining massive modes, and what four-dimensional gauged supergravity, AdS vacua and subtruncations result?

sources.title: Duality orbits of non-geometric fluxes

evidence.text: Which duality-inequivalent gauging orbits admit a geometric higher-dimensional origin, and can generalized Scherk–Schwarz reductions of double field theory realize genuinely non-geometric orbits?

sources.title: Modave lecture notes: Introduction to Exceptional Field Theory

evidence.text: How can exceptional hidden symmetries organize the full equations of maximal supergravity, and how does this reformulation support consistent truncations and KK mass calculations?

sources.title: Survey of supergravities

evidence.text: Which supergravities, matter couplings and gaugings have been constructed across dimensions, and how can their component formulations and duality-covariant descriptions be summarized?

sources.title: Lectures on Gauged Supergravity and Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: How can supergravity gaugings be constructed covariantly under the ungauged theory's duality group, and how do their deformation parameters encode geometric, p-form and non-geometric fluxes?

sources.title: Higher derivative supergravities in diverse dimensions

evidence.text: The Noether procedure keeps off-shell supersymmetry transformations fixed because algebra closure is independent of equations of motion. With only on-shell transformations, action deformations generally require corresponding transformation deformations order by order.

sources.title: Higher derivative couplings with multi-tensor multiplets in 6D supergravity, action and anomalies

evidence.text: Use the ADM time-space split and Henneaux–Teitelboim Hamiltonian formulation. Only spatial two-form components enter the action; the Poincaré lemma integrates their Euler–Lagrange equations to the duality equations, introducing temporal components as integration data.

sources.title: New F$^{4}$ invariants in five-dimensional supergravity

evidence.text: Compare standard and dilaton Weyl superconformal constructions after integrating out auxiliary fields. Use integration by parts, Bianchi identities and leading two-derivative equations to remove redundant terms, yielding a common Riemann basis with no derivatives of field strengths and at most first derivatives of scalars.

evidence.text: Differentiate spinorial relations from the superspace torsion and curvature Bianchi identities, then take the spinor trace and two-index/four-index sigma projections to extract the dilaton equation, a divergence equation for L, and its antisymmetrized derivative identity.

sources.title: Scalar masses in general N=2 gauged supergravity theories

evidence.text: Uses stationarity conditions, the quaternionic curvature sum rule and special-Kähler curvature identities to cancel curvature dependence from the averaged matrix for one gauged isometry. Linear-algebra arguments relate its eigenvalues to extremal masses of the full system.

sources.title: AdS boson stars in string theory

evidence.text: Construct nonlinear RN-Ψ and boson-star families as coupled radial ODE boundary-value problems, using asymptotic expansions at the AdS boundary and regular horizon or origin. The author reports thermodynamic first-law agreement better than 10^{-6} for hairy black holes.

evidence.text: Extend eigenvalue inequalities through Rayleigh min-max principles, Lipschitz approximation, coarea inequalities and heat-semigroup arguments; analyze surface examples using magnetic Schrödinger and Legendre equations.

destinations.title: At fixed gravitino mass and cosmological constant, does generic N=2 gauged supergravity impose a universal upper bound on the lightest scalar's squared mass, and how does the answer depend on matter content and the number of gauged isometries?
Can boson stars be constructed in a type IIB supergravity embedding with a gauged scalar symmetry, and how do their mass-charge branches relate to charged thermal states at low energy in global AdS5?
What bulk geometries result from finite BMS supertranslations of Minkowski space, and which conserved charges distinguish their supertranslation Goldstone field when supertranslation charges vanish?
Can an endpoint wall preserve any supercharges compatible with its unbroken Poincaré symmetry? The answer depends on minimal lower-dimensional spinors and bulk chirality.

What group-theoretical mechanism makes axion-like S-fold deformations flat, how are they interpreted in five dimensions, and can it generate nonsupersymmetric deformations of the N = 4, SO(4)-symmetric S-fold that remain perturbatively stable in four-dimensional supergravity?
How are the explicit supersymmetric AdS4 geometries parameterized before applying the bottleneck bounds?

How do local/global symmetries, conserved currents, scalar charges and black-object thermodynamics of minimal five-dimensional supergravity relate to those of its circle reduction, the four-dimensional T3 model?

How can bosonic solutions of minimal gauged N = 2 supergravity in four dimensions admitting a Killing spinor be characterized systematically, and which supersymmetry fractions and explicit geometries occur? The review also considers extending the construction to external matter sources.

Determine necessary and sufficient Killing-spinor conditions for matter-coupled six-dimensional gauged supergravity, identify which field equations remain independent, and construct a supersymmetric dyonic string with active hyperscalars.

How do classical supersymmetric magnetic black holes in general N=2 supergravity evolve through vector-multiplet moduli space, and when can their space-time geometry be obtained explicitly from special Kähler geometry?
How can the symmetry Lie superalgebras of supersymmetric AdS × X backgrounds be identified geometrically, including cases where explicit Killing spinors are unavailable?
